test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A fast local of Mumbai takes 45 minutes less than a slow local for a journey of 150 km. If the speed of the fast local is 10 km/h more than that of the slow local, find the speed (in km/h) of the slow local train.
solution:
**Given:**

Total distance of journey = 150 km

Time = 45 minutes

⇒ Time = (3)/(4) hours

**Formula used:**

Speed = (Distance)/(Speed)

**Calculations:**

Let the speed of the slow train = x km/h

According to the question,

Speed of the fast train = Speed of the slow train + 10 = x + 10

Again, 

Time of fast train = Time of slow train - (3)/(4)

(150)/(x + 10) =(150)/(x) - (3)/(4)

⇒ (150)/(x) - (150)/(x + 10)= (3)/(4)

⇒ (150x + 1500 - 150x )/(x² + 10x) = (3)/(4)

⇒ (1500)/(x² + 10) = (3)/(4)

⇒ x² + 10x - 2000 = 0

⇒ x² + 50x - 40x + 2000 =0

⇒ (x + 50)(x - 40) = 0

⇒ x = 40, - 50

The speed of the slow train (x) = 40 km/h

The speed of the fast train (x + 10) = 50 km/h

**∴ The speed of the slow local train is 40 km/h.**
